music.title: We Wish you a Merry Christmas

narration.text: Ho, ho, ho! Good evening, everyone. Santa here, with a little Christmas magic... just for you!
Bushes... wake up! One by one, let's see those lovely Christmas colours.
Windows... it's your turn to shine! One pane at a time. That's the way!
Christmas tree... show us your sparkle!
Icicles... twinkle like a frosty winter's night.
Splendid! Now, let's bring those Christmas colours together.
Rainbows... fill the windows with Christmas magic!
Windows... send that golden sparkle round the house, and back again!
And now... a grand Christmas finale!
From all of us at the North Pole... have a wonderful Christmas! Good night, everyone. Ho, ho, ho!
